observations.B01: Fresh crop rotated 90 degrees clockwise. Initial word is dark and overwritten, tentatively multiplicités; no confident underlying correction can be separated. Modu- ends the first line and laires begins the second. Hat-M with subscript looped G is inserted below laires before de by a curved guide.
observations.B02: Five rows under one brace numbered 74. Each M has an angular hat and an exclamation with a separate dot. The second left subscript is heavily inked but reads 1,2. Middle repeated wording is represented by an unbroken stroke in row two and broken strokes in rows three and four, without silently expanding the ditto marks. Row three after the arrow contains a large hatched cancellation: a product-like top bar and lower alpha-in-opening-brace-alpha-zero-comma survive, but the remainder cannot be securely recovered; only that fragment is recorded. A separate cancellation immediately before the opening parenthesis of the new group subscript is tentatively amalgamation. No closing parenthesis after the two I terms is clearly visible. Row four has a small cancelled superscript-like mark above the group symbol, retained as uncertain. Hats over the I symbols are angular and distinct. The page number 29 sits above the text and is not a formula exponent.
observations.B03: NB has one underline. A small scribbled cancellation immediately after it may be an abandoned D. Both M symbols have hats but no distinct exclamation superscripts in this note. Opère is crossed by a horizontal stroke, and the replacement s’envoie sits above it. Last words read par l’intermédiaire de.
observations.B04: The quotient is written Z/2, followed by a separate dot and the parenthesized pair of looped S symbols, each with subscript 4. Beneath is prod. followed by a literal one-half sign and direct; it has not been silently expanded to semi-direct. A tiny isolated dash near the far right is not connected to the expression.
observations.B05: The line begins On peut considérer que par rapport aux. Hat-M subscript G is above the line and attached between modulaires and de by a curved guide. At the right, the cancelled baseline word is tentatively savoir; qui sont donc: is written above it. The first word of the lower line is read schémas from the opening s/ch and remaining low strokes.
observations.B06: Fresh crop rotated 35 degrees clockwise to level the slanted note. The lower word has the tall initial l and later t of élémentaire, followed by a clear exclamation and closing parenthesis. The short upper word is tentative plus. A page-border stroke at the upper left is excluded.
observations.B07: Equation number 75 and the two exclamation superscripts are clear. The I in the first group subscript has no separate visible angular hat, unlike the I symbols in B02, so it is retained undecorated. The last word is abbreviated trivialt rather than expanded to trivialement. Stray top-edge ink and a lower-edge hat belong to neighboring prose and are excluded.
observations.B08: There is an opening pair of quote strokes before cas, another before nouveaux, and a closing pair after nouveaux; this unmatched outer opening is retained rather than regularized. Both displayed M symbols have hats and exclamation points. Upper-edge fragments from the preceding table are excluded.
observations.B09: The first word is low connected en. The final letter of the second word has a downward right hook rather than a tall t stem or crossbar, supporting tous; no spelling normalization is applied.
observations.B10: Both quotation marks and the accented initial é are visible. The long middle horizontal belongs to the joined handwriting and t cross-stroke, not a separate cancellation. A top-left fragment from the preceding line is excluded.
observations.B11: The target line is on a rising baseline; the initial pour lies near the bottom edge. Dim. has a visible period. The following word appears plural modulaires with a terminal hook. The relation before 2 has a lower equality stroke. Upper-edge ink from the preceding line is excluded.
observations.B12: A single horizontal bar covers two descending uprights, read capital Pi; the separate smaller low-right stroke reads subscript 1. No hat or prime is visible.
observations.B13: The smaller interlinear insertion reads discrets (i.e. dans le contexte analytique), including the closing parenthesis. The main baseline reads impliqués dans ces cas, donnera la clef. Fragments of moins complète at the upper edge and the following line at the lower edge are excluded.
observations.B14: Separate pencil foliation reads 59, with a round upper loop and descending tail on the second digit. Kept as margin writing.
observations.B15: The authorial page number reads 29. The isolated vertical stroke at the lower edge belongs to the word via in the table and is excluded.
